reason: A DeepSeek Harness settings plugin for visually managing MCP servers, including configuration changes, enablement, connection status, and connection testing.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置页面中可视化管理 MCP 服务器，支持配置增删改、启停切换、状态查看和连接测试。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness settings plugin for visually managing MCP servers with configuration editing, enablement controls, status monitoring, and connection testing.

capabilities: Lists installed and enabled MCP servers
Adds, edits, removes, enables, and disables MCP server configurations
Persists changes to the profile cordis.patch.yml file
Tests MCP connections and retrieves initialization and tool-list results
Connects to configured stdio and streamable-http MCP servers
